title: A smooth algebra over a field is reduced
statement: Let $K$ be a field and let $A$ be a commutative $K$-algebra. If $A$ is smooth over $K$ in the sense that $K\to A$ is finitely presented and formally smooth (equivalently, its cotangent complex has vanishing degree-one homology and its module of differentials is finite projective [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]), then $A$ is reduced: for every $a\in A$ and $n\geq1$, $a^n=0$ implies $a=0$.
